helpful: metrics/statpack.json exposes the per-Term prefix_est_grant_rate and prefix_weighted_resolved fields, so the risk-set pool can be reproduced exactly rather than from the rounded table
the staged retrieval_log.json's result_capture markers made the all-unobserved log readable on its queries alone
the frozen context block on each staged prediction carried both band and salience_version, so the basis choice was mechanical
gaps: the evaluator's own snapshot is the decided one, so confirming that a forward cell was not mis-provisioned relies on the prediction's created_at and context.snapshot_date rather than on seeing the snapshot it read
notes: No corpus query, CourtListener call, or web search was needed: a cert cell with a resolved outcome, a version-matched band table, and three forward logs that name no outcome material.
